s.t:
If you're reading this on your way from 5am spin class to festival fast-pass, you're CELSIUS®— an everyday hustler with the essential energy to aim high, and go the extra mile wherever your goals take you.
Joyful by design, sunny by nature, and unapologetically bold. If your bestie has you saved in their phone as "Icon," you're ALANI NU® — confident, colorful, and bringing main-character energy to every moment.
SoCal in your soul, attitude in your stride. If gravity doesn't stop you and "impossible" sounds more like "dare you," you're ROCKSTAR®— a born rebel, raising the bar with mind-body energy and zero compromise.
---
Together, we're Celsius Holdings, Inc.— a global CPG company united by three powerhouse brands and one incredibly talented team.
At Celsius, we pride ourselves on empowering our people. Every employee has a stake in our success. We create a collaborative culture built on inclusivity, innovation, and a belief that great ideas can come from anywhere.
And we're on our way to building something bigger: a category where energy isn't just consumed, it's lived—where performance meets personality, brand becomes community, and every can crack sparks a statement.
This is the future of modern energy. This is Celsius.

Ready to take your career to the next level? Join our team and redefine what it means to be energized.
Field-Based: Remote; role requires presence in assigned market.
This is a driving position. A valid U.S. Driver's License required; applicants must pass an MVR (Motor Vehicle Record) screening.
Role Type: Full-Time

As the Field Marketing Manager, you'll be the face of the CELSIUS® or ALANI NU® brand on the ground, driving awareness, trial, and conversion across your region. This is your opportunity to activate national marketing strategies through impactful local experiences that connect with consumers and energize retail. You'll bring leadership, creativity, and a passion for building community through smart, scalable field programs.

s.t:

Dallas, TX - CELSIUS® ONLY

Experience : 5+ years in grassroots and brand marketing, preferably in CPG, food, or beverage; 3+ years in team management or field leadership

Strong background in community engagement, event marketing, and project management
Familiarity with regional events and cultural moments that drive brand relevance
Demonstrated ability to lead teams, manage cross-functional priorities, and deliver under pressure
Self-motivated with excellent organizational and problem-solving skills
Strong interpersonal and communication skills
Comfortable working independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment
Willingness to travel within the assigned region
Valid U.S. driver's license
Physically able to lift up to 25 lbs and stand for extended periods

Implement 360° marketing campaigns aligned with national goals and regional sales strategies
Build partnerships with local influencers, community leaders, and media outlets
Develop and manage local sponsorships and sampling opportunities
Lead high-impact consumer activations and events; measure performance to optimize ROI
Recruit, train, and lead a team of part-time Brand Ambassadors
Collaborate with Sales and distributor teams to support in-store visibility and retail success
Manage regional marketing budgets, product forecasting, and campaign reporting
Oversee operational logistics, including warehouse space, product inventory, and company vehicle use
Coordinate with Finance to process invoices and manage expenses
Support broader marketing and sales initiatives as needed

Long- and short-term disability
Life insurance
10 Vacation days per year subject to accrual policy

401(k) with Company match
Identity theft and legal services

Join us in building the future of finance.
Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.
The Robinhood International & Crypto team’s mission is to democratize finance for all by making investing simple, safe, and accessible. We’re a collaborative group of marketers, product thinkers, and strategists working together to drive adoption and engagement expansion markets.
As a Product Marketing Manager , you’ll play a key role in how we connect with customers and drive growth for Robinhood in expansion markets. In this role, you’ll lead go-to-market strategy for new products and features and help shape the product growth strategy for our brokerage and crypto offering in a highly regulated and fast-moving environment.

We’re looking for a consumer product marketer who can build and execute strategies that drive awareness, adoption, and growth, partnering closely with cross-functional teams across product, creative, research, legal, compliance, and more!
This role is based in our UK office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.
At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

Own product marketing for Robinhood in expansion markets, leading positioning and go-to-market strategy for new products and features, as well as evergreen initiatives that drive adoption and engagement.
Partner with product, lifecycle, performance, creative, social, events, communications, legal, and compliance to define and deliver strategic growth initiatives.
Serve as a strategic advisor to product teams, helping inform roadmaps and product improvements based on user insights, market feedback, and regional learnings.
Develop differentiated narratives and messaging informed by user insights, testing, and a deep understanding of the target audience
Craft marketing plans and creative direction that drive relevance, adoption, and sustained engagement for Robinhood.
Define success metrics and track impact in partnership with product and data science teams, ensuring alignment with legal and compliance requirements.

7+ years experience in product marketing (or adjacent consumer growth/product roles) in tech.
Strong growth marketing leadership, including shaping positioning, messaging, and integrated launch plans across channels.
Ability to break down complex concepts so they’re simple, clear, and human.
Strong relationship-building skills and ability to lead cross-functionally through influence.
Data-informed decision making, including familiarity with experimentation and performance measurement.
Fluency across key marketing channels (e.g., lifecycle, performance, in-product, and social) and how to sequence them for impact.
Comfort operating in regulated consumer products and partnering closely with legal and compliance teams.
Thrives in a fast-paced environment with a bias toward action.

Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership.
Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs.
Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more.
Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more!
Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.
Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs.
Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.

Observability Pipelines is one of Datadog's fastest-growing product lines, helping enterprises optimize telemetry costs, modernize observability architectures, and strengthen security operations.

As the Senior Product Marketing Manager for Observability Pipelines, you'll own the go-to-market strategy for a rapidly expanding business at the intersection of observability, security, and AI.

You'll partner closely with Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, Analyst Relations and Sales Enablement to shape category positioning, accelerate product adoption, and drive competitive success.

This is a highly strategic role for someone who enjoys building new categories, influencing product direction, and delivering measurable business impact.
At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

Own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for Observability Pipelines, including positioning, launches, adoption, and field readiness.
Develop differentiated messaging and category narratives that position Datadog as the intelligent telemetry pipeline platform while supporting competitive displacement against solutions such as Cribl and Splunk.
Lead analyst relations efforts for the telemetry pipelines market, including Gartner Magic Quadrant participation, analyst briefings, and market education.
Build and maintain sales enablement assets including pitch decks, competitive battlecards, demos, customer stories, and sales plays that help account teams accelerate pipeline and revenue.
Partner closely with Product Management, Sales, Customer Marketing, Enablement, and Customer Success to translate customer insights into compelling product narratives and customer proof.
Measure and optimize go-to-market performance by tracking product adoption, pipeline influence, competitive outcomes, and launch success metrics.

5+ years of Product Marketing experience supporting enterprise B2B SaaS products.
Experience developing and executing product positioning, messaging, launches, competitive intelligence, and sales enablement for technical products.
Background marketing infrastructure software, observability, data platforms, security, developer tools, or adjacent enterprise technologies is strongly preferred.
Able to communicate effectively with highly technical audiences while translating complex capabilities into clear customer value.
Demonstrated success partnering cross-functionally across Product Management, Sales, Enablement, Analyst Relations, and Customer Marketing.
Passionate about observability, security, AI, and helping customers solve complex operational challenges through innovative technology.
Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

MongoDB is hiring a Staff Product Marketing Manager to build and own our go-to-market narrative for the Public Sector vertical, with a focus on Federal Government and the broader public sector market. This is a foundational hire for MongoDB’s Industry Verticals product marketing function: you will define how MongoDB’s unified data platform, spanning cloud, on-premises, and hybrid database deployments with integrated, production-ready AI capabilities, shows up for government buyers.
You’ll turn a major compliance milestone into a durable competitive differentiator: developing the positioning, messaging, and sales-ready content that helps government agencies, systems integrators, and cloud/public-sector resellers understand why MongoDB is the right data platform for mission-critical, regulated workloads.

You do not need prior government or public-sector work experience to succeed in this role — you need to be an excellent product marketer who can get fluent in a new domain quickly and partner closely with the compliance, product, and sales experts who already are.
This role can be based in one of our MongoDB hub offices in the U.S. or remotely in the U.S.

Own positioning and messaging for MongoDB’s Public Sector go-to-market, leading the federal GTM and launch related activities
Translate MongoDB’s data platform capabilities — document database, search, vector search, stream processing, and integrated AI — into mission-relevant outcomes and value propositions for government buyers and the systems integrators who serve them
Partner with Compliance, Security, Industry Solutions and Product teams to accurately represent related certification requirements in external-facing content, staying current as MongoDB pursues additional authorizations (e.g., DoD Impact Levels)
Build the public sector sales enablement toolkit: battlecards, pitch decks, discovery guides, ROI/value models, and competitive intelligence tailored to federal buying processes and procurement vehicles
Develop content — solution briefs, customer decks, whitepapers, case studies, and web content — that makes the case for MongoDB in regulated, mission-critical environments, working within the constraints of public sector reference and PR approval processes
Partner with Field Marketing, Demand Generation, and Partner Marketing to plan and launch public-sector campaigns, events, and co-sell motions with cloud hyperscalers, resellers, and systems integrators
Run competitive and win/loss analysis specific to the public sector segment, feeding insights back into positioning, sales plays, and product roadmap conversations
Serve as the go-to product marketing voice for public sector launches, readiness reviews, and executive/customer-facing engagements

5–8+ years of product marketing (or closely related GTM/solutions marketing) experience in B2B enterprise software or SaaS, with a track record of owning positioning, messaging, and launches end-to-end
Proven ability to translate complex technical products into clear, differentiated value propositions for both technical and executive audiences — direct experience with data infrastructure, databases, or cloud platforms is a strong plus, not a requirement
Comfort learning and communicating regulatory/compliance concepts well enough to brief sales and build customer-facing content — prior compliance or public-sector experience is a plus, not required
Experience building and running sales enablement programs (battlecards, playbooks, ROI tools) and partnering closely with sales and field marketing teams
Strong cross-functional operator: comfortable driving alignment across product, compliance, sales, partner, and communications teams without direct authority
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to flex between mission-oriented narrative and technical depth
Self-starter who can operate with a fair amount of ambiguity and build structure in a newer, less standardized go-to-market motion
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience; MBA or technical/quantitative background a plus
No security clearance or prior government employment required. U.S. work authorization required; ability to work from a MongoDB office or remotely within the U.S.

Direct experience with FedRAMP, DoD Impact Levels (IL4/5/6), CMMC, or ITAR — either holding the knowledge yourself or having partnered closely with a compliance/SME team to market around it
Familiarity with federal contract vehicles and procurement channels, such as GSA Schedules, NASA SEWP, CIO-SP3, or other GWACs
Experience working with, or marketing through, federal systems integrators and resellers (e.g., Booz Allen Hamilton, Leidos, SAIC) or federal-focused aggregators/resellers (e.g., Carahsoft-style channel partners)
Understanding of federal budget and fiscal-year buying cycles and how they shape campaign and launch timing
Prior experience marketing to federal government buyers
Experience marketing database, data platform, analytics, or AI infrastructure products
About MongoDB
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software.

MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI.

Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy , we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world!

Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

Aircall is seeking a Regional Marketing Manager to own and execute the regional marketing strategy across Iberia and Italy. You will lead the translation of global priorities into high-impact local initiatives, partnering closely with local sales, partnerships, customer success, and global marketing teams.
This role is accountable for building sustainable pipeline, accelerating revenue, and elevating Aircall’s brand presence across Iberia and Italy through locally-relevant, insight-driven marketing. You will bring a strong strategic perspective, deep market understanding, and a bias for executional excellence, leading full-funnel programs across digital, events, partners, product launches, and regional campaigns.
You’ll thrive here if you are a data-driven, collaborative marketer who wants to shape regional growth, influence cross-functional GTM direction, and operate with high levels of ownership and autonomy.

Own and execute the regional marketing strategy for Iberia and Italy, acting as the strategic marketing lead for the region and driving full-funnel pipeline growth through digital, partner, content, events, webinars, and local activations.
Partner closely with regional Sales, Partnerships, and Account Management leaders to align on GTM priorities, pipeline goals, and shared revenue outcomes.
Translate global messaging, and product launches into high-impact local programmes that drive brand relevance, engagement, and conversion across the Iberia and Italy markets.
Provide market insights, competitive intelligence, and performance analysis to shape strategy, optimise programmes, and guide regional investment decisions.
Lead partner marketing initiatives with priority channel and alliance partners to strengthen brand presence and generate leads and pipeline.
Ensure consistent communication with Sales and cross-functional teams, keeping stakeholders informed of upcoming initiatives, campaign performance, and optimisation plans.
Own reporting for regional marketing performance, including weekly and monthly updates, pipeline reporting, initiative ROI, and recommended next steps.

5 years or more of experience in high technology B2B enterprise software or SaaS preferred.
Deep knowledge of the Iberian and Italian markets with a proven track record of marketing to SMBs and supporting global sales and marketing efforts.
Language skills: Native or near-native proficiency in Spanish as well as proficiency in Italian strongly preferred. Fluent proficiency in English is also a requirement.
Strong background in developing fully integrated marketing strategies tailored to specific markets.
Proficiency in HubSpot, Salesforce, Looker, or similar tools.
Exceptional project management and problem-solving skills.
Highly autonomous, with the ability to prioritise, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines with minimal supervision.
Excellent time management, organisational, communication, and collaboration abilities.
Positive, energetic attitude and initiative, with a strong work ethic.
Location: This is a hybrid position requiring a few days per week at our Madrid office.

At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.
Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.
We’re hiring a Product Marketing Manager to help shape how Linear’s products are brought to market and understood by customers.

This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Design, CX, Sales, and Marketing, and is responsible for turning technically sophisticated product work into clear narratives, strong launches, and high-quality customer-facing experiences.

You’ll go deep on the product, define positioning and messaging, and drive execution across the surfaces that matter most—from in-product copy and changelogs to enablement, documentation inputs, email, and launch communications.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines product judgment, excellent writing, and strong cross-functional leadership.
Location & work mode
Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America and the United Kingdom. You can work from anywhere within these regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

Develop positioning, messaging, and core narratives for feature releases, key launches, and strategic product narratives
Partner closely with Product management, Engineering, and Design to refine how products are presented across in-product and external surfaces
Create and coordinate launch deliverables such as changelogs, demos, enablement materials, email, social copy, and go-to-market communications
Equip Sales, CX, and other customer-facing teams with the context and materials they need to communicate new launches effectively
Bring customer insight, product understanding, and market context back into product and launch decisions

Exceptional writing and editorial judgment, with the ability to make complex ideas feel clear and compelling
Strong positioning and messaging skills grounded in customer problems, product truth, and differentiation
Great project management skills and ability to track large amounts of detail.
Comfort going deep on product details and building credibility with Product, Engineering, and Design
Strong judgment, ownership, and the ability to operate autonomously while maintaining a high quality bar
We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows
Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday
Paid co-working space or desk

5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays
4 months paid parental leave
Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter
Regular team events and off-sites
Remote-first with no required commute

Die BogenSportWelt ist einer der führenden Anbieter für Bogensportartikel in Europa. Über unsere eigenen Onlineshops, verschiedene Marktplätze, B2B Händler & 3 Fachgeschäfte vertreiben wir unser Sortiment im In- und EU-Ausland. Neben dem eigenen Fulfillment nutzen wir auch Amazon Fulfillment. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen erfahrenen Online Marketing Manager (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt E-Commerce.
Aufgaben
1. Marketing- & Kanalstrategie
Entwicklung einer klaren, differenzierenden Kanalstrategie inkl. Prioritäten, Roadmap und Budgetplanung
Wettbewerbs- & Marktanalysen, Zielgruppensegmente und Ableitung konkreter Wachstumshebel
Planung und Orchestrierung von Go-to-Market-Ansätzen für Produkte und Themenwelten (Marketing-seitig)
2. Umsetzung Performance
Operative Steuerung und Optimierung relevanter Kanäle (z. B. SEA/Google Ads, Display, Affiliates, E-Mail/CRM, Retail-POS-Marketing, Print/Mailing)
Performance-Management mit klaren Zielwerten (z. B. MER/ROAS, POAS, CAC, CR, AOV) sowie kanalbezogene Entscheidungsfindung (Attribution/Mix)
Tracking-Setup und Qualitätssicherung in Zusammenarbeit mit E-Com/Tech (GA4, Google Tag Manager, Events, Consent/Tracking-Logik)
Ausbau des CRM/Lifecycle (Welcome, Winback, Retention) mit klarem Fokus auf Segmentierung und Listenwachstum – idealerweise mit Klaviyo
Website & Conversion: CRO, QA/Monitoring sowie A/B-Testing auf Shop/Checkout/Landingpages
3. Strategisches SEO & GEO
Entwicklung einer strategischen SEO & GEO-Roadmap SEO& GEO-Basics in Abstimmung mit Tech/E-Com
Fokus auf nachhaltiges organisches Wachstum und messbare Conversion-Effekte
4. Markenführung anwenden
Anwendung der Markenpositionierung, CI/CD-Guardrails, Tonalität und Storytelling in allen Online-Marketing-Touchpoints (Kampagnen, Ads, CRM, Landingpages, Content)
Sicherstellen eines konsistenten Markenauftritts durch saubere Umsetzung der Guidelines
5. Produktlaunches & Themenwelten
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagement & Entwicklung sowie systematisches Einspeisen von Kundenfeedback & Markttrends in die Vermarktung
Planung und Umsetzung der Marketing-Aktivitäten rund um Produkteinführungen mit definierten Zielwerten (Absatz/Umsatz)
Planung und Umsetzung von Kampagnen und Sales-Events in den Frontends der Websites (z. B. Startseite, Kategorie-/Landingpages, Banner-/Teaserflächen, Aktionswelten) und Abstimmung mit anderen Kanälen (Shops, Marktplätze)
6. Innovation & Test-and-Learn
Trend-Scouting (E-Commerce, Kanäle, Creatives, AI-Tools, Automation) und Aufbau eines Test-&-Learn-Backlogs mit dokumentierten Learnings
Qualifikation
Erfahrener Online Marketing Allrounder mit Fokus auf Performance
Erfahrung im Performance-Marketing (SEA/Google Ads, YouTube, Display) und im E-Commerce-Umfeld
CRM/Lifecycle-Know-how (E-Mail/Automation, Segmentierung) – idealerweise Klaviyo
SEO-Erfahrung (strategische SEO, Keyword-/Themencluster, Onpage/Technical Basics, Zusammenarbeit mit Content/Tech)
CRO/UX-Grundlagen und Erfahrung mit Testing-Ansätzen
Sehr gutes Zahlen- & Analyseverständnis (GA4, GTM, Tracking/Tagging, KPI-Auswertung) inkl. POAS/Profitabilitätsblick
Erfahrung mit Attributions-/Analyse-Tools wie Admetrics und Profitmetrics von Vorteil
Strukturierte, selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise; hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein

Eine verantwortungsvolle Position von Tag 1 in einem wachsenden Unternehmen mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum
Flexible Arbeitsweise mit Office in Anklam, und Home-Office-Möglichkeit
Kurze Entscheidungswege, direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und praxisnahe Zusammenarbeit
Ein agiles kollegiales Umfeld, junges Team mit starkem Zusammenhalt

As the Director of Product Marketing at Storyblok, We're looking for a Product Marketing Director to shape how we position, launch, and grow our product in the market- particularly in the US, UK and EMEA.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can translate complex technical capability into compelling, credible narratives — and who's comfortable in the room with engineers as much as with executives.

You'll own the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing at a stage where positioning decisions have outsized impact on growth.
You will guide a talented team, focusing on sales enablement, website conversion, feature adoption, and Storyblok’s market positioning with industry analysts and customer review platforms. A key responsibility is to elevate our product marketing function to influence revenue, customer acquisition, and market leadership.
Your mission is to enable Storyblok to win in the market by clearly articulating our value, differentiation, and future direction.

You're genuinely comfortable operating in technical territory, not just translating it secondhand.

You can read API documentation, understand headless CMS architecture, and hold a credible, detailed conversation with engineers and technical evaluators about how the product actually works — its components, integration points, and trade-offs versus alternative approaches.

This fluency shows up in the quality of your messaging: you write positioning that developers trust because it's accurate, not just persuasive.
You've likely worked hands-on with developers before, whether as a technical product marketer, solutions engineer, technical product manager, or in an engineering-adjacent role, and you know how to earn credibility with a technical audience rather than assume it.

Product Positioning & Messaging
Own and evolve our core messaging and differentiated value proposition across all audiences (developers, marketers, partners, enterprise buyers), setting the strategic framework the wider team executes against
Direct ongoing customer, market, and competitive research programs to ensure messaging stays relevant, differentiated, and current
Set the standard for translating product capabilities and roadmap into solution-oriented, benefits-led messaging that resonates across the buyer journey
Ensure messaging consistency and governance across all channels — website, campaigns, sales assets, analyst briefings, and customer communications
Go-To-Market Strategy & Execution
Own GTM strategy for major product and feature launches, driving alignment across Product, Growth, Sales, Customer Success, and Content leadership
Define phased rollout strategies that drive awareness, adoption, and revenue impact across key customer segments
Set the standard for launch toolkits — messaging frameworks, FAQs, competitive positioning, product one-pagers, internal training — and build the team capability to produce them at scale
Establish the measurement framework for launch performance and adoption, using it to continuously improve release execution
Sales Enablement & Sales Plays
Build a structured sales playbook program aligned to product capabilities, customer pain points, and vertical use cases.
Equip revenue teams with high-impact content (battlecards, ROI calculators, solution briefs, demo scripts, objection handling).
Partner directly with Sales Leadership on rep onboarding, conversion effectiveness, and keeping messaging aligned to evolving sales motions
Use sales performance data, win/loss interviews, and customer feedback to identify and prioritize enablement investments
Analyst & Review Site Strategy
Define and lead the analyst relations strategy to secure meaningful participation in key analyst evaluations (e.g., Gartner Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave, IDC MarketScape).
Orchestrate analyst briefing cycles, submission processes, and relationships that enhance Storyblok’s visibility and influence.
Own our presence and growth strategy on review platforms (G2, Gartner Peer Insights), including review acquisition and profile optimization
Establish ongoing monitoring and response mechanisms for public reviews and rankings
Website & CRO Performance
Partner with Growth Marketing and Web leadership to ensure product positioning is clearly and consistently represented site-wide
Set priorities for CRO initiatives that improve engagement, conversion, and self-serve funnel performance
Define messaging strategy and success metrics for key product pages, feature highlights, and trial flows
Direct ongoing testing and optimization of messaging, CTAs, layouts, and journey flows based on data
Lead, mentor, and inspire the Product Marketing team to deliver high-impact outcomes aligned with company goals.
Set team structure, priorities, and ways of working in partnership with marketing leadership
Coach the team on messaging craft, technical fluency, and cross-functional collaboration
Foster a culture of ownership, curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning.
Develop individual growth plans, conduct regular performance reviews, and ensure team members have access to relevant coaching and training opportunities.
Ensure strong collaboration across Product, Growth, Brand, and Sales teams to drive alignment and accountability.

8+ years of experience in Product Marketing, with at least 2+ years in a leadership role.
Proven experience in a fast-growing B2B SaaS environment.
Strong understanding of PLG motions, SaaS business models, and the product lifecycle.
Demonstrated success in GTM execution, analyst engagement, and pricing strategy.
Exceptional communication skills and executive presence.
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder influence.
Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Marketing Automation, G2, and PMM platforms (e.g., Klue) a plus.
Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

At Deliverect, our API-first platform is revolutionizing commerce by providing a connected suite of on and off-premise solutions. We empower both the food and retail industries to expand their revenue and simplify their operations, creating seamless experiences for businesses to sell anywhere and deliver everywhere. Join us in this exciting journey, where your contributions will directly impact how businesses connect with their customers in a rapidly evolving global market.

The Marketing Department at Deliverect is a dynamic team of creative, data-driven, and results-oriented professionals dedicated to empowering businesses to deliver exceptional order experiences.

By placing customers at the heart of our strategies and leveraging data to guide every decision, from campaign development to execution, we craft resonant marketing initiatives and continuously optimize our tactics.

Collaboration is central to our approach, as we work seamlessly with other departments to align our efforts with overarching business goals. Committed to continuous growth and innovation, we strive to position Deliverect as an industry leader in marketing, redefining and elevating every interaction into a memorable journey

As a Product Marketing Manager at Deliverect, you will play a critical role at the intersection of product development and marketing strategy. You will be the voice of our customers and partners, ensuring that the products we build are relevant and impactful. Your strategic insights and innovative marketing campaigns will drive product adoption and customer satisfaction, contributing significantly to Deliverect's ambitious growth mission.
This is a full-time, fixed-term, hybrid role with a flexible work schedule, offering 3 days in our either our Amersfoort, Madrid, London or Ghent, Belgium offices and 2 days from the comfort of your home.

Plan and execute Go-to-Market (GTM) strategies for product & feature launches: From the inception of new products and features, you will take insights from the product team and act as the crucial link, ensuring information is digestible for both customers and GTM teams.

This means creating a coherent narrative, compelling product positioning and messaging frameworks that communicate the value we create for customers by speaking directly to their needs, and creating the enablement tools and materials (battle cards, one pagers, etc) that provide the information required for GTM to accelerate deal success and closing opportunities.

You will work closely with the product, marketing, and PR teams to ensure all materials are ready for successful launches including internal training. .
Track and analyze product marketing & campaign metrics such as user engagement and product adoption rates: You will assess the effectiveness of marketing strategies by monitoring key performance indicators that should inform the development of additional inside the product strategies to foster adoption, as well as inform the external marketing strategies.
Act as a crucial feedback loop between the market and product development: In collaboration and to support the product managers, you will gather actionable insights from sales, customer success, and market research to inform future product improvements and new features, ensuring continuous product enhancement. You will also utilise online resources, AI tools and benchmarking to perform direct comparisons between our products and competitors.

5+ years of experience as a Product Marketing Manager or in a similar role in the business-to-business SaaS industry.
Strong understanding of B2B marketing principles and product-led growth
Ability to develop compelling product positioning and messaging.
Proficiency in marketing automation tools and analytics platforms.
Strong analytical skills to translate data into actionable insights.
Excellent project management skills to juggle multiple campaigns and deadlines.
Proven ability to work independently and take ownership of projects.
Collaborative spirit and ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams (Sales, Product Development, etc.).
Strong communication skills to gather feedback and persuasively present insights to align on strategy.
Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to develop engaging marketing campaigns and assets.
Comfortable using data to inform decisions and measure the success of marketing initiatives

An understanding of the food service industry is a plus.
Passion for B2B SaaS: Enjoys promoting complex solutions to businesses.
Master’s degree in Marketing/business or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
Proficiency in more than 2 languages is a plus.

Marqeta is seeking a high-energy Senior Demand Generation Manager to lead demand generation strategy across our global sales segments, spanning North America and EMEA. In this strategic role, you'll set the direction for integrated campaigns that generate qualified pipeline for our commercial and enterprise sales teams worldwide as well as building integrated campaigns within our B2B Enterprise marketing funnel.
You'll work closely with sales leadership, product marketing, marketing operations, and external media partners to design and run full-funnel programs across events, paid media, SEO/AEO, and outbound campaigns, primarily within our Named Account List segments.

The ideal candidate knows how to build demand strategies for enterprise accounts that flex across regional and country-level nuances, activate prospect data and campaign insights across the funnel, and coach a growing team to deliver on shared pipeline goals.
PLEASE NOTE: This is a hybrid role and requires employees to be based within 35 miles of our London office. You will be expected to work on-site two days a week, on Tuesday and Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on the other days.
The Talent team will share more details if selected for the "Recruiter" Interview. We'd love for you to join us!
The Impact You'll Have
Own demand generation strategy and performance across global sales segments (North America and EMEA), driving core KPIs: target account engagement, intent progression, and pipeline generation.
Directly manage and develop a Demand Generation Manager, setting priorities, reviewing campaign performance, and coaching toward pipeline outcomes.
Plan, execute, and optimise integrated demand generation campaigns across regions, adapting programs to country- and segment-level nuances.
Own strategy across channels including paid media (Google, LinkedIn, Reddit, programmatic), events, media partnerships, email, SEO/AEO, and outbound prospecting support.
Partner very closely with ABM, automation & sales enablement functions to deliver pipeline
Serve as a key strategic partner between sales and marketing leadership, translating field insights and campaign data into program-level recommendations.
Establish and lead a structured testing agenda across the team, sharing insights that inform broader marketing strategy.
Partner with marketing operations to ensure accurate tracking, attribution, and reporting across regions.
Regularly report on regional and global program performance to marketing and sales leadership.

8+ years' experience in B2B demand generation, performance marketing, or growth marketing, including experience managing or mentoring others.
B2B Enterprise sales motion experience, in particular working on ABM campaigns that have taken accounts from net new to closed won. Experience with Named Account Lists and Look-Alike lists is highly desirable.
Proven track record delivering pipeline through integrated programs across multiple regions or markets (North America and EMEA strongly preferred).
Deep understanding of demand strategy across paid media, events, SEO/AEO, and outbound marketing support, particularly as it impacts all stages of the sales funnel.
Strong commercial mindset with a clear understanding of how marketing influences deal progression and revenue outcomes across a global funnel.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce and Marketo (or similar automation platforms).
Strong analytical and testing mindset, with the ability to interpret marketing data, share performance results, and influence action across a cross-functional, cross-regional team.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building programs from scratch without fully defined playbooks.

Experience in fintech, SaaS, or embedded payments.
Familiarity with platforms like Demandbase, Google Ads, GA4.
Experience with GTM automation and AI marketing technologies.

At the center of it is Felix, our AI teammate, which takes real work off a team's plate — running follow-up across calls, texts, and emails today, with more of the team's day-to-day work coming next. We're not another tool in the stack.

We're the system that powers it — learning, adapting, and executing in real time so teams can focus on growth, not guesswork. If you're excited about building an AI product that's changing how an entire industry works, you'll fit right in.

About You: You are a strategic, hands-on product marketing leader who knows how to turn product, customer insight, market context, and company strategy into a clear story the whole business can use. You are excellent at positioning and messaging. You can cite examples of how you’ve applied strategic narrative frameworks.

You know how to simplify complex products without dumbing them down. You can turn AI, data, CRM, automation, and workflow complexity into buyer value, field confidence, and customer clarity. You are a great writer — and you actually like writing.

You will produce and review a lot of copy in this role: web, deck, launch, enablement, and customer-facing.

You pair that craft with real strategic judgment, and you collaborate well across departments — an exceptional communicator who can work across founders, executives, Product, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Enablement, and RevOps, influencing without authority and keeping the company from fragmenting as product velocity increases.

This is not a manager-first role. You will guide existing and future PMM resources, and may build a small team over time — but your sleeves are rolled up every day. You write. You synthesize. You build. You ship. You are a quarterback on the field, not a coach on the sidelines. You are also AI-native in how you work.

You use AI to move faster, research smarter, analyze customer and sales signals, and operate like a larger PMM function before adding headcount.

And you will have leverage most PMMs never get: a Technical Product Marketing Manager as a close collaborator on deep product work, a GTM AI team that builds agentic solutions alongside you, and an AI agent that understands everything about the product. One more thing about timing: we are at the moment where the story gets set.

The next two quarters of positioning and narrative work will matter more than the next two years. You should find that energizing.

You Will: Drive the Fello + Felix story Drive the core positioning, messaging, buyer narrative, and product story for Fello and Felix — co-owning the strategic narrative with our President, who holds final approval — and keep it consistent as the product, market, and commercial motion evolve.

Translate Fello ’s category and strategic narrative work into clear GTM language across the website, sales deck, demo narrative, launch materials, customer proof, and enablement. Work closely with our Technical Product Marketing Manager — a collaborator, not a direct report — on deep product, data, and integration storytelling.

Define the language Fello uses — and just as importantly, the language we avoid. Make complex product capabilities easy for customers, Sales, CS, and Marketing to understand and use.

Turn product velocity into market absorption Own launch and release readiness across GTM teams: launch briefs, release tiering, internal communications, field enablement inputs, customer messaging, and post-launch feedback.

Make sure every meaningful product change is translated into why it matters, who it matters for, how we explain it, and what teams need to do next. Partner closely with Product on what is shipping, what changed, and what the field needs to know — and build the feedback loop that brings customer, competitive, and adoption insight back into Product.

Build the Sales and CS enablement spine Create and guide the core enablement materials: talk tracks, objection handling, demo narrative, FAQs, proof points, launch guides, and customer-facing value messaging.

Define adoption messaging for the first 30, 60, and 90 days of the customer journey, and partner with CS on adoption friction, time-to-value gaps, and proof opportunities. Turn customer wins, usage signals, objections, and ROI examples into proof that Sales, CS, Marketing, and executives can use.

Partner with field leaders to understand whether the story is landing and where teams need more clarity, proof, or coaching. Lead the PMM function Run the PMM operating model across positioning, launch execution, enablement support, and customer proof, guiding existing and future PMM resources as the function scales.

Partner with our GTM AI team to build agentic solutions for PMM — content systems, launch coordination, signal analysis — and put the product AI agent to work across your deliverables. Assess where Fello needs full-time ownership, contractor support, AI leverage, or cross-functional partnership.

Build repeatable PMM systems, not one-off heroic work — and raise the quality bar for clarity, narrative, launch execution, and field readiness. Success Looks like: Fello + Felix has one clear story across the website, sales deck, demo narrative, enablement, onboarding, and customer proof.

Sales and CS teams can explain, demo, onboard, and support Fello + Felix with confidence and consistency. Product launches are clearer, better sequenced, and easier for GTM teams and customers to absorb.

Customers understand what they bought, how to adopt it, and how to get value faster — and that proof compounds into expansion, retention, and advocacy. PMM operates as a scaling system for the company, not a set of scattered deliverables.

You Have: 8+ years of experience in B2B SaaS product marketing, with meaningful experience in a startup or scale-up environment. Excellent positioning and messaging judgment. You can turn strategy, product detail, customer truth, and market context into a story that sells.

Experience owning PMM where the function was underbuilt, ambiguous, or moving fast — solo PMM, first PMM, Head of PMM, or Director-level PMM leading a small team. Proven ability to build product launch and release systems that help GTM teams understand, sell, onboard, and support new capabilities.

Strong field enablement instincts: sales narrative, demo story, objection handling, proof points, and customer-facing value messaging. Enough product depth to understand AI, data, CRM, automation, and workflows — and translate them into buyer value. A hands-on operating style.

You are comfortable writing the brief, building the deck, shaping the talk track, and shipping the work. Exceptional writing craft. You produce and review copy at high volume and a high bar — headlines, web, deck, launch, and enablement — and you make other people’s writing better.

Comfort working directly with founders and executives — pressure-testing assumptions and translating AI Fluency Is a Hard Requirement : We hire at the “Adoptive” level or above on Zapier’s AI fluency framework. Strong signals: an AI-built content system, launch coordination automations, or a customer-signal analysis workflow you deployed. As Senior Event Marketing Manager at Databricks, you will report to the Director of Corporate Events and collaborate with global teams. You will lead field initiatives and sales enablement for major events like the Data + AI Summit and World Tour. Your focus will be delivering premium field experiences, activating Sales colleagues, refining workflows, and strengthening cross-functional alignment to scale these programs and their business impact.
Impact Statement
Within the first one to two years, success in this role will look like:
Flagship events such as Data + AI Summit and World Tour are consistently treated as strategic field growth engines, with clear motions that translate event engagement into high-quality opportunities and healthy pipeline for priority and strategic accounts.
Clear targeting frameworks (including quotas, eligibility to attend, and strategic account selection) are defined with sales leadership, so the right customers, partners, and reps are prioritized for each program.
Field teams have a simple, repeatable event playbook (pre-, during, and post-event) that is widely adopted, with strong participation in event campaigns and follow-up activities from sales, marketing, and partner teams.
Attendee and customer experiences across field-focused programs are cohesive and premium from invitation through post-event follow-up, resulting in stronger relationships with strategic accounts, partners, and executive stakeholders.
Event performance is transparently tracked through agreed-upon dashboards and reports built in partnership with analytics and operations, giving leaders clear visibility into attendance, engagement, and downstream revenue impact to inform future investment decisions.
Lead flow from events into sales systems is reliable and timely, with well-structured campaigns, lead routing, and MQL definitions that enable BDR/SDR teams to act quickly and consistently on event leads.
Incentive structures (such as SPIFFs and recognition programs) are thoughtfully used to drive meaningful field engagement with event motions, without creating unnecessary complexity for sales or operations.
Cross-functional programs such as executive forums, partner summits, product announcements, and training and certifications are integrated into a unified field event strategy, so that messaging, targeting, and experiences feel connected for customers and internal teams, and internal stakeholders see the program as well-run with clear goals, communications, and meeting cadences that reduce friction and allow them to focus on driving outcomes.
What we look for

s.h: To achieve the outcomes above, you bring
s.t:
Extensive experience leading complex B2B marketing events or event portfolios end-to-end, including ownership for business impact and not just execution.
Proven track record partnering closely with sales and field teams to design event strategies, plays, and enablement that drive measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes.
Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams, agencies, and stakeholders while maintaining clarity on goals, budgets, and timelines.
Deep comfort working with CRM, marketing, and analytics tools to define targets, interpret event performance, and make data-informed recommendations about where to focus and how to improve.
Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional teams, and represent the event strategy and results clearly.
A metrics-driven, test-and-learn mindset, continually looking for ways to improve attendee experience, field engagement, and event ROI through experimentation and refinement.
Ability to operate both strategically and tactically: setting the overall field event vision and frameworks while also diving into the details needed to ensure world-class execution.

At Speckle, we're on a mission to shake up the AEC (Architecture, Engineering, and Construction) industry. To do that, we're building the data layer for AEC to operationalize how the built environment industry works with data and automation.

Think of us as a cross between Github and Palantir, with an opportunity to significantly impact a $10 trillion industry. Our platform already powers workflows on billion dollar projects at leading firms like Suffolk Construction, SOM, Multiconsult, WSP, and Stantec.
Now, we're focused on taking a paradigm-shifting product and bringing it to as many customers as possible. We're building a generational company that will revolutionize the way one of the world's largest industries works. We're doing that by breaking down barriers and connecting architects, engineers, and designers across every project stage with data.
Speckle is backed by top-tier investors, working with some of the most innovative teams in AEC who are tired of outdated workflows and ready to transform how their organizations use data. Our dynamic team is spread across the U.S. and Europe, we value flexibility and hold regular in-person working sessions to keep us moving in the same direction, quickly.

Speckle is looking for a Product Marketing Lead to own how we package, position, and sell a category-defining product into the enterprise.
You'll be the connective tissue between product, sales, and the market. You'll turn a technically deep platform, currently positioned as the design intelligence layer for AEC, into crisp packaging, sharp messaging, and the sales enablement content that helps our team win six-figure enterprise deals. When a member of our sales team walks into a room with a General Contractor or Engineering Service Provider, the narrative, the deck, the one-pager, and the ROI story they're carrying are yours.
This is a hands-on, build-from-zero role. It's a good fit if you've marketed technical or data products into complex B2B buyers, can translate product capability into buyer value without hand-holding, and are as comfortable writing the words as you are building the system that scales them.
We're looking for a marketer who can do three things exceptionally well:
Own product packaging and positioning : Define how we name, bundle, price-frame, and differentiate our products for each buyer segment.
Craft messaging that resonates : Translate a complex platform into clear, compelling narratives that land with technical and executive buyers alike.
Build the sales enablement engine : Create the decks, one-pagers, case studies and battlecards that make every seller more effective.
Grow Speckle's thought leadership: Build on our position as a leader in bringing real data infrastructure to AEC and position us as a trusted partner as the industry navigates the AI transformation through thought-provoking content and webinars.
This role requires 7+ years of product marketing experience (ideally in technical, data, or platform B2B), strong writing chops, and a builder mindset. We're looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity and is equally comfortable authoring the messaging themselves as they are creating the frameworks and systems that let it scale.
This is a U.S.-based role. You must be located in and working from the Eastern (ET) time zone to stay closely aligned with our sales and product teams.

You'll be part of our Growth team. At Speckle, we're a small, high-performing team building something ambitious. We move fast, default to action, and give talented people room to run.
We're building a rocket ship and we move fast. We don't have layers of management or endless meetings, we have smart people who take ownership, ship quickly, and learn from what works (and what doesn't).

We default to trust and autonomy. You'll have real ownership and impact on product/customers/growth from day one. We don't micromanage and we hire people who don't need it.

Radiology Partners , through its owned and affiliated practices, is a leading radiology practice in the U.S., serving hospitals and other healthcare facilities across the nation.

As a physician-led and physician-owned practice, our mission is to transform radiology by innovating across clinical value, technology, service, and economics, while elevating the role of radiology and radiologists in healthcare.

Using a proven healthcare services model, Radiology Partners provides consistent, high-quality care to patients, while delivering enhanced value to the hospitals, clinics, imaging centers and referring physicians we serve.

Lead enterprise product positioning and messaging for RP’s technology portfolio, including AI-enabled offerings, ensuring a clear, differentiated narrative that aligns to growth priorities and strengthens market credibility.
Develop and evolve product and solution narratives (including clinical, technology, and AI-enabled capabilities), translating features into buyer-relevant value propositions, proof points, and outcomes.
Define and maintain product marketing frameworks (personas, use cases, messaging hierarchies, and solution taxonomy) that enable consistent interpretation and application across teams and channels.
Build future-facing platform stories and go-to-market narratives that increase relevance, resonance, and adoption—positioning RP’s technology offerings as category leaders.
Own go-to-market strategy for new products and major releases, partnering with product, sales, and growth teams to define target segments, ideal customer profiles (ICPs) and personas, use cases, packaging assumptions, and launch objectives.
Establish launch governance and operating rhythms (intake, prioritization, cross-functional planning, resourcing, and timelines), ensuring launches are aligned to enterprise priorities and executed with speed, quality, and rigor.
Define launch readiness standards (core messaging, demo storyline, web and campaign inputs, sales enablement, and success metrics) and use stakeholder feedback and performance results to drive continuous improvement.
Oversee development of a sales enablement strategy and roadmap that equips Sales, Client, and partner-facing teams to articulate product value consistently and win in competitive cycles.
Set clear enablement expectations and KPIs (e.g., content adoption, training completion, pipeline influence, win/loss insights); review results regularly, remove barriers, and ensure continuous optimization.
Oversee sales enablement governance, including prioritization, content quality standards, and tool/channel strategy (e.g., playbooks, battlecards, FAQs, demo scripts), ensuring accuracy, compliance, and field usability.
Lead customer and market insight efforts (voice of customer (VOC), buyer interviews, win/loss, usage and adoption signals) to sharpen go-to-market strategy and improve product-market fit.
Partner with Product and Sales to develop competitive intelligence (landscape, differentiation, battlecards, objection handling) that improves sales effectiveness and informs roadmap priorities.
Own analyst and category narrative inputs in partnership with Marketing & Communications; ensure consistent messages across PR, awareness, demand, and sales materials.
Support pricing and packaging strategy by providing market context, value metrics, willingness-to-pay insights, and packaging recommendations; partner on tests and iteration as offerings evolve.
Partner with executives, product, clinical, and marketing teams to develop compelling points of view, narratives, and proof points (e.g., articles, keynote storylines, webinars, reports, and customer stories) that build credibility and demand.

Define and report on KPIs and dashboards for product marketing impact (e.g., launch outcomes, pipeline influence, enablement adoption, competitive win rates, and messaging performance); use insights to optimize strategy and demonstrate value to stakeholders.
Work closely with the SVP, Marketing & Communications and cross-functional executive leaders to establish effective collaboration, drive clarity on priorities, and improve go-to-market execution velocity and quality.

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field.
12+ years of progressive product marketing, solutions marketing, and/or go-to-market leadership experience in B2B technology; including 5+ years of people leadership.
Proven success commercializing technology products and/or platforms; experience with AI/ML-enabled solutions strongly preferred.
Demonstrated experience leading go-to-market strategy and product launches for new products and major releases.
Experience owning positioning, messaging, competitive differentiation, and sales enablement in a complex, multi-stakeholder organization. Experience partnering with cross-functional teams and managing agency/vendor relationships, budgets, timelines, and quality across multiple concurrent launches and go-to-market initiatives.

Qualifications All qualifications must be met by the closing date of this announcement-08/07/2026-unless otherwise stated in this vacancy announcement. Competitive candidates must also meet Time-in-Grade requirements as defined in 5 CFR 300, Subpart F.

For current Federal employees, if hours worked per week are not included on your resume, you must submit a non-award SF-50 as part of your application to be used to validate your work schedule and determine the amount of specialized experience that you will be granted.

An award SF-50 will not be acceptable documentation for which to consider your amount of qualifying experience. For periods of time that reflect military service, the DD-214 or Statement of Service is sufficient to meet the work schedule requirement as the service dates will be reflected.

For all other applicants who are not current federal employees, your resume must state either "full-time" (or "40 hours a week") or "part-time" with the number of hours worked per week to ensure proper crediting of specialized experience.

Minimum Qualification Requirements: To qualify for this position, you must meet the following minimum qualifications: To qualify for this position at the GS-13 grade level: Experience: To qualify, you must possess at least one full year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-12 level in the Federal service (obtained in either the public or private sectors).

Specialized experience is defined as demonstrated experience: (1) Leading design team(s) in the development and design of national park brand identity packages and marketing and communications campaigns and products for major national or global brand(s); leading design team(s) in the development and design of exhibits and/or interactive experiences for major national or global brand(s) or institution(s); and creating design products with attention to business goals and objectives, including strategy and audience targeting.

(2) Applying a wide range of advanced design principles, concepts, and practices.

(3) Providing oversight to ensure design meets universal design standards, policies, guidelines, and best practices, including the Architectural Barriers Act accessibility standards and Sections 504 and 508 of the 1973 Rehabilitation Act, as amended to establish compliance and effective accessibility for visitors with disabilities.

(4) Leading and providing program direction for other NPS employees and partners including, but not limited to, Policy and Management Analysts, Visual Information Specialists, Project Managers, Park Managers, Contract Specialists, Solicitors, and Agency Leadership.

You must include hours per week worked and GS-level of federal positions listed in your resume.

Volunteer Experience: Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

LemFi (Series B) is building the go-to financial app for the Global South.
Moving to a new country shouldn’t mean starting from zero. That's why our team of 400+ spanning 20+ countries is building a financial ecosystem that helps immigrants stay connected to home, build stability, and create wealth regardless of where they are from or where they live.
What began as fast, affordable remittances is now evolving into a complete platform for multi-currency accounts, payments, credit, and long-term financial growth.
With millions of users across the globe, we process over $1B in monthly transactions to 30+ countries, proving that borders shouldn't limit financial opportunity.

CRM at LemFi doesn't run on batch and blast. As Senior CRM Manager - Automations, you'll own the lifecycle journeys that carry a customer from first sign-up to their tenth product, across remittance, credit, savings and the insurance products coming next. This is the person who builds onboarding, retention, reactivation, referral and cross-sell journeys that adapt to real customer behaviour, not a calendar.
You'll sit close to Product, Data and Growth, and report directly into the Head of CRM. Your journeys are core infrastructure for the business. Get them right and every other campaign, product launch and market entry gets easier.
What you’ll build and own
Design and own the lifecycle journeys, onboarding, retention, reactivation, that run without you touching them daily.
Build referral and virality programmes that turn customers into the acquisition channel.
Launch cross-sell journeys that introduce customers to credit, savings and insurance at the right moment, not the loudest one.
Set up the triggers, segments and logic that make each journey react to real behaviour.
Test, measure and iterate. Kill what doesn't move the number, scale what does.
Partner with Product and Data to get the event tracking and attributes your journeys actually need.
Report on lifecycle performance in numbers a CMO can act on, not a dashboard nobody opens.

4+ years in CRM, lifecycle or marketing automation, ideally in fintech or another high-frequency product.
Proficiency with Liquid language for dynamic, personalised content across journeys.
Hands-on expertise in a major marketing automation platform ( Customer.io , Braze, Iterable or similar). You build the journey yourself, you don't just brief it.
A track record of onboarding, retention or reactivation programmes you can point to, and the numbers they moved.
Comfortable with SQL and event-based data models. You query the data behind your own journeys.
Experience building referral or virality mechanics is a strong plus.
Judgment on trigger logic and segmentation that holds up across multiple products and markets.
Bias to ship and test over perfecting a brief.
Comfort with AI tools for content generation and personalisation at scale.
Familiarity with a BI or analytics tool such as Looker, Amplitude or Mixpanel for self-serve reporting.

Lived experience or deep empathy with the life of our users, the millions who move countries to build something better.
Language skills in French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Wolof or Swahili.
Experience with WhatsApp or SMS as a lifecycle channel.
Background in remittance, cross-border payments or diaspora-focused products.
Experience designing loyalty or points-based programmes, beyond straight referral.
Experience operating in a regulated or compliance-sensitive comms environment.

Love shouldn’t be expensive, yet those working hardest for their families often face predatory fees and banking exclusion. We're changing this.
At LemFi, you won’t be just a cog in a machine. Whether designing products, scaling operations, or telling our story, you’ll tackle complex challenges with real, immediate impact. Your work goes beyond metrics - it puts money back in families’ pockets and offers access to the previously excluded. Join us to make a meaningful difference, where high performance is a lifeline for millions.
You can connect with us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play .

Description
Constructor is an AI-first search and product discovery platform built for enterprise ecommerce, helping leading retailers deliver personalized digital shopping experiences that drive revenue, conversion and profit. Our technology delivers consistent $10M+ lifts for brands including Sephora, Petco, Under Armour and Birkenstock.
We are looking for a Director of Product Marketing to help tell that story.
This is a highly hands-on role for someone exceptional at product positioning, messaging and storytelling. You'll define what makes Constructor genuinely different and translate that into a compelling narrative that resonates with prospects, customers and the market.
Our platform is powerful, technically sophisticated and constantly evolving. We need someone who can bring clarity to that complexity, identify the real value and differentiation of our products, and create positioning that makes customers think: "This is clearly better—and we need it."
This position is equal parts strategist and builder - setting direction, developing people, and rolling up your sleeves to build the many artifacts that form a robust product marketing org.

You will work closely with our product leaders to launch new products, add-ons and features, with our content marketing team to create thought leadership, with growth marketing to drive pipeline and product content and with sales to ensure the GTM functions are enabled on key launches and competitors.

Any feature or product launch, with the product team, will include a bill of materials focused on value proposition, personas, objection handling, competition and more.

Product Positioning & Messaging
Own and evolve differentiated positioning for Constructor's platform, products and key capabilities.
Develop a deep understanding of what makes our technology unique and valuable to customers.
Translate complex technical capabilities into clear, compelling customer value propositions.
Create messaging that clearly communicates why Constructor, why now and why we're different.
Build messaging frameworks and narratives that align Marketing, Sales and Customer Success.
Ensure our positioning is grounded in genuine product strengths and customer needs, not simply what competitors are saying.
GTM & Product Launches
Create compelling product narratives, value propositions and messaging that bring products and capabilities to life.
Develop sales enablement and customer-facing materials that support launches, adoption and expansion.
Partner with Sales to understand customer needs, objections and deal dynamics, continuously improving positioning and enablement.
Lead and orchestrate product launches from strategy through execution that are crisp, focused, and actually land with customers
Partner with Product on roadmap communication and prioritization
Identify gaps in capabilities and proactively build the function to address them
Customer & Market Insight
Build a deep understanding of our customers, prospects, buyers and their challenges.
Understand the ecommerce, search and product discovery landscape and where Constructor creates differentiated value.
Engage with customers and prospects to understand what resonates and why they choose Constructor.
Monitor the market and competitive landscapes.
Identify opportunities to improve how we communicate product value throughout the customer lifecycle and the deep understanding of buyer personas and ICP.

Experience
8-10 years experience in B2B SaaS product marketing, ideally within a technical or complex product environment.
Proven track record developing genuinely differentiated positioning and messaging.
Ability to take complex technology and turn it into a simple, compelling story that customers understand and value.
Experience bringing products or capabilities to market and creating GTM materials that support adoption and growth.
Strong experience partnering with Product and Sales to develop positioning that works both externally and commercially.
Experience in ecommerce, retail technology, search, discovery is a plus.
Skills
You are a strong storyteller who can communicate complex technical concepts in a simple, clear and persuasive way.
You are technically curious, with a good understanding of how products work and what makes technology better, as well as a familiarity with AI/ML fundamentals.
You are commercially minded, with an understanding of how strong positioning can drive pipeline, revenue, adoption and expansion.
You are an excellent communicator with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to create and present compelling ideas.
You are both strategic and hands-on, comfortable setting direction while also getting into the detail needed to make things happen.
You are creative and curious, willing to challenge conventional thinking and explore new ways to differentiate.
You have an analytical mindset and can use market research and performance data to support strategic decisions, with experience in ROI analysis and experimentation.
You have excellent project management skills and strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage complex initiatives from concept through to execution.
You have a growth mindset, bringing creativity, ambition and a proactive approach to problem-solving and innovation.

About Scopely
Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others.

Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.
Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami.

Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue.

Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.
Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.
Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/ .
